answer: Keys that only gossip inside a private mesh stay cheap to clone. An applicant mints a falcon tag = sha3_512(pubkey||wing_salt)[:11] and docks at three public jetties drawn from a 20-sector atlas by xor(checkpoint, tag, i), kin skipped, 9 hours apart over 27 hours. At jetty i they post a berth-root merklizing 8 fresh foreign receipts and pay 1.4 POA; the keeper hmac-signs the tag and root. Cost: 17 POA bonded 4 epochs plus fees, refunded if complete. Peers recompute the draw and signatures. A reused tag, self-picked jetty, or missed dock slashes 29% to the keeper and freezes that salt 5 epochs.
